You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 5e498ff117c19fd80181b5bb09ecb024b552ece8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Al Cooper <alcooperx@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Dec 2017 14:28:48 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] phy: phy-brcm-usb: Fix two DT properties to match bindings
 doc

Change "brcm,has_xhci" and "brcm,has_eohci" device tree properties
to the preferred "brcm,has-xhci" and "brcm,has-eohci". This also
matches the existing device tree bindings document.

Fixes: 49859e55e364 ("phy: usb: phy-brcm-usb: Add Broadcom STB USB phy driver")
Signed-off-by: Al Cooper <alcooperx@gmail.com>
Acked-by: Florian Fainelli <f.fainelli@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Kishon Vijay Abraham I <kishon@ti.com>

diff --git a/drivers/phy/broadcom/phy-brcm-usb.c b/drivers/phy/broadcom/phy-brcm-usb.c
index 195b98139e5f..d1dab36fa5b7 100644
--- a/drivers/phy/broadcom/phy-brcm-usb.c
+++ b/drivers/phy/broadcom/phy-brcm-usb.c
@@ -338,9 +338,9 @@ static int brcm_usb_phy_probe(struct platform_device *pdev)
 			      ARRAY_SIZE(brcm_dr_mode_to_name),
 			mode, &priv->ini.mode);
 	}
-	if (of_property_read_bool(dn, "brcm,has_xhci"))
+	if (of_property_read_bool(dn, "brcm,has-xhci"))
 		priv->has_xhci = true;
-	if (of_property_read_bool(dn, "brcm,has_eohci"))
+	if (of_property_read_bool(dn, "brcm,has-eohci"))
 		priv->has_eohci = true;
 
 	err = brcm_usb_phy_dvr_init(dev, priv, dn);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/phy/broadcom/phy-brcm-usb.c`**
- The device tree property checks for "brcm,has_xhci" and "brcm,has_eohci" have been modified to use the preferred naming convention "brcm,has-xhci" and "brcm,has-eohci" respectively.
  - Changed:
    ```c
    if (of_property_read_bool(dn, "brcm,has_xhci"))
    ```
    to:
    ```c
    if (of_property_read_bool(dn, "brcm,has-xhci"))
    ```
  - Changed:
    ```c
    if (of_property_read_bool(dn, "brcm,has_eohci"))
    ```
    to:
    ```c
    if (of_property_read_bool(dn, "brcm,has-eohci"))
    ```

### Relationships
- The modifications in the `phy-brcm-usb.c` file are aimed at aligning the code with the existing device tree bindings documentation. The changes ensure that the property names used in the code match the preferred naming conventions, which is important for consistency and correctness in device tree configurations. This patch addresses a bug related to the incorrect naming of these properties, as indicated by the fix reference to a previous commit.

Based on your summary and the commit message in the patch, you need to:

1. analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 
2. output the file name that is most likely to cause the bug. 



Provide a response strictly in the following format:
Root cause:<Root cause>
file:<file name>

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (of_property_read_bool(dn, "brcm,has_xhci"))
if (of_property_read_bool(dn, "brcm,has_eohci"))
```
Reason:
The use of incorrect device tree property names "brcm,has_xhci" and "brcm,has_eohci" instead of the preferred "brcm,has-xhci" and "brcm,has-eohci" means that the properties may not be recognized when the device tree is parsed. As a result, the flags `priv->has_xhci` and `priv->has_eohci` may not be set correctly, potentially leading to malfunctioning USB PHY driver functionality.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (of_property_read_bool(dn, "brcm,has-xhci"))
if (of_property_read_bool(dn, "brcm,has-eohci"))
```
Reason:
The patch corrects the device tree property names to the preferred format "brcm,has-xhci" and "brcm,has-eohci". This ensures that the properties are recognized correctly when the device tree is parsed, allowing the flags `priv->has_xhci` and `priv->has_eohci` to be set as intended, thus restoring the expected functionality of the USB PHY driver.
